text:
Maya: Heads up — our newest prompt ingestion batch (batch-2026-03-18) has ~18% exact dupes and ~12% near-duplicates. Seeing weird labeler disagreement spikes on those near-duplicates.

Omar: Ugh. Do we have the dedupe step running? Thought the minhash pass ran in preproc.

Josh: It did, but the sample had a higher rate of short-variant paraphrases that slip past the simhash threshold. I pushed a quick job 10m ago to lower the simhash similarity threshold from 0.92 -> 0.88 for short (<=64 token) prompts.

Priya: Lowering threshold sounds fine but will blow up the labeler queue with near-duplicates showing up as distinct items. Any plan to collapse duplicates in the queue UI?

Claire: Also noticing inter-annotator agreement drop. Kappa is 0.56 on the affected tasks (intent classification). Target for golden set is >0.7. We should avoid flooding labelers with near-identical items — wastes budget and hurts QA.

Maya: Agree. Proposed steps: 1) run an additional dedupe pass with minhash + fuzzy-token-hash for short prompts, 2) add an automated cluster collapse in the labeling queue that groups items with >=0.9 normalized-levenshtein and shows a representative, 3) refresh golden set by sampling 200 items from new cluster centroids for adjudication. Anyone strongly opposed?

Omar: +1 to clustering. For fuzzy-token-hash I can add a cheap bloom-filter based pre-check to avoid O(n^2) comp. I'll open an RFC PR with perf numbers.

Josh: Command I ran (for transparency):
```
python infra/ingest/dedupe.py --batch batch-2026-03-18 --minhash-threshold 0.88 --short-token-cutoff 64 --out /tmp/dedupe-20260318.json
```
I can schedule a follow-up job that writes cluster metadata to the labeler queue API.

Priya: If we group in the queue, we need the UI to show members and allow labeler to expand cluster. Otherwise they might miss subtle variants. I'll add an MVP flag to the labeling UI: "Show cluster members".

Claire: For golden set refresh: propose we sample 200 cluster centroids and send to senior raters (3-way adjudication) + compute agreement. If kappa < 0.7, hold model onboarding for that promptset.

Maya: Note: this is urgent because the quantized 4-bit candidate model we onboarded yesterday flags a lot of these near-duplicates as low-confidence and triggers fallback logic, which inflates our perceived regression rate. If we don't fix dedupe / golden set, we'll get false positives in evals.

eval-bot: Automated eval report: new-model-quant4b | overall pass: 92% | flagged prompts: 189 | top failure mode: low-confidence on short paraphrases | report: https://redwood.internal/evals/2026-03-18/quant4b-failures

Omar: That eval-bot link confirms it. The quantized kernel has slightly different tokenization rounding behavior around punctuation -> produces different embeddings for short prompts. That magnifies dupes. Two-pronged fix: dedupe + add tokenization-normalizer preproc for eval harness.

Josh: Will add normalizer on the ingestion path and a quick backfill for the batch. Backfill ETA ~2h.

Priya: Labeling ops: I'll pause auto-assign for the affected task, re-route to a small adjudication pool, and enable the UI cluster view. Will notify vendors to hold bulk labeling invoices for that task until we confirm golden pass.

Claire: Metrics to watch after fix: kappa, avg time-per-label (should drop if dedupe fixed), flagged-false-positive rate in eval (should drop), and volume of cluster-expansions in UI.

Maya: Thanks. Omar — ping me when RFC is up. Josh — ping when backfill completes. Priya/Claire — coordinate on golden adjudication schedule.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job dedupe-backfill-20260318 started by Josh at 1752146880. Logs: https://k8s.redwood/logs/dedupe-backfill-1752146880

Josh: Backfill started. I'll post when finished (expected by 1752148000).

Omar: RFC opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/824 (includes perf numbers and bloom-filter sketch). @Maya please review.

Maya: Reviewing now. Quick decision: proceed with clustering + cluster-collapse UI flag as MVP. If after golden adjudication we still see kappa < 0.7, we'll roll back the batch and re-ingest after manual curation.

Priya: Noted. I'll set up a 30-minute adjudication block at 17:00 PT today and invite senior raters.

Claire: Will prepare a small diff of the golden set to include recovered edge cases (abbreviations, email-snippets).

Maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
